name: Industrie
lede: An all-electric apartment building in Albany wanted its rooftop patio in use on cool evenings, without a gas fire table in sight. A freestanding Eclipse heater brings heat and light to the deck and comes inside for the winter.

beats: Industrie, The Rosenblum Companies’ all-electric, zero-emissions building, has a rooftop patio that serves as its residents’ social hub, with views of the Downtown Albany skyline and the Hudson River.
The developer wanted the patio usable into the cooler months and evenings. In an all-electric building, gas fire pits and heaters were ruled out: the warmth had to come without combustion.

Bromic recommended an Eclipse Smart-Heat Freestanding heater, provided heat maps for the furniture layout and worked with Rosenblum’s engineers on the install. A dedicated outlet set into the deck avoids visible cords, and the heater can be taken down and stored when the rooftop closes for winter.

quote.text: Bromic’s Eclipse heater allows our residents to comfortably enjoy this key amenity well into the cooler months.
